tools.name: upload_temporary_video
tools.description: Uploads a user-provided video to VideosTemporales and returns a temporary human viewing page. Always give the returned share_url to the user exactly; never construct or expose a direct media URL.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "upload_temporary_video" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
